cohort: 22,479 parturients at a single institution from April 1, 2017 to September 9, 2020
finding: There was a statistically significant association between lower predelivery platelet counts and both QBL and PPH, but the clinical significance of these findings is debatable because the differences in blood loss were small.
mod_finding: The median difference in QBL was statistically significantly higher in both VD and CD patients with thrombocytopenia compared to those without (25 mL [95% CI: 16-32] and 57 mL [95% CI: 31-87], respectively).
